title: Vocal mixing and mastering with a report
lead: Your vocal and beat mixed into one track at streaming loudness, with a before and after report.

hero.caption: Before and after: the shape of the sound.
hero.alt: Before and after: the shape of the sound.

problem: The vocal was recorded at home: peaks on syllables, uneven loudness, sibilance on s, rumble. Together with the beat it sounds uneven and quiet.
built: Syllable peaks reduced from 11 to 2 dB; loudness spread of the voice from 11 to 1 dB.
Tone: rumble at 200-500 Hz from +11.9 to +7.6 dB, boxiness at 500-1000 Hz from +6.1 to +3.4 dB, clarity at 2-5 kHz from -3.5 to -1.8 dB.
The track with the voice brought to -10.0 LUFS; the voice alone was -27.4 LUFS.
A report and a beat-without-voice to finished-track waveform.

shots.caption: What was done to the voice: syllable peaks, loudness spread and sibilance before and after, plus tone changes per band.
shots.alt: What was done to the voice: syllable peaks, loudness spread and sibilance before and after, plus tone changes per band.

shots.caption: Loudness of the finished track: −10.0 LUFS against a −10 target; the voice alone was −27.4 LUFS.
shots.alt: Loudness of the finished track: −10.0 LUFS against a −10 target; the voice alone was −27.4 LUFS.

steps: You send your vocal and your beat.
The vocal is cleaned: peaks, loudness, sibilance, tone.
The mix is brought to streaming loudness and checked after compression.
You get the track and a before and after report.
stack: A browser-based app on my own computer (the software itself is not for sale)
offer: Mixing of your finished vocal (WAV, MP3, M4A or FLAC) with your beat.
Mastering to streaming loudness and a check after compression.
A free test fragment on your material before payment.
not_included: Vocal recording and writing lyrics; The beat itself (a separate service); A guarantee against Content ID.
price_en: On request, after a short brief
